review.title: Demo: A & M Landscaping and Lawncare, Columbus (2D)
review.text: Next lead after Handyman: A & M Landscaping (family firm in Upper Arlington since 2006, A+ BBB, 2017 site, public email). 2D demo built from their own facts: services, hardscapes, the founders' story, service areas, quote form. Navy on warm sand, Red Hat type, stand-in photos from Wikimedia Commons (credits page linked in the footer). Checks: layout checker clean at 1280 and 375, design gate OPEN 4 (the areas section has no picture). Every required skill loaded and logged in demos/am-landscaping/SKILLS-USED.md. The 3D version is next; no pitch is drafted or sent yet.

review.title: Demo: Handyman Services in Columbus (2D)
review.text: Rebuilt from scratch as you asked, not patched. New design: warm stone and pine green, Red Hat type, and a clean copy of the design kit (the old build had edited the kit CSS). The root cause of the overlaps is gone: no phone action bar (the stray blue bar), no tall photo beside the form, and every section sized to fit at 1280x720 and 1920x1080. Checked with the layout checker at 1920, 1440, 1280, 1024, 768, 390 and 375, plus full-page screenshots at 1920, 1280, 768 and 375: no text over images, no empty bars. Design gate: OPEN with one finding, a gap under the quote form on phones that my last fix caused. I undid that fix and the checker at 390 is now clean. Also swapped two bad stand-in photos (a soldier in camouflage, a postcard back). Sources and what I took from each: demos/handyman-columbus/INSPIRATION.md. The 3D version is next, in its own folder with its own link.

To: help@handymanincolumbus.com
Subject: Quick redesign idea for handymanincolumbus.com

Hi there,

I noticed handymanincolumbus.com still runs on a 2011-era layout that's hard to use on a phone, even though you offer 24-hour emergency and commercial repairs across central Ohio.

I built you two quick demos of a modern site:
Classic: https://handyman-columbus-kitebright.pages.dev
3D / interactive: https://handyman-columbus-3d-kitebright.pages.dev

They're just demos, made without your real photos, logo or content. Here's how the real one would work:
- You send me your photos, logo and service details, and I build the site with them.
- I show it to you on a live Zoom call, or send a private preview link like the ones above.
- We change it until it's exactly to your taste.
- Pricing is $50 per page for the classic version and $85 per page for the 3D one. Once you're happy, there's an optional $20/month maintenance plan for updates and fixes.

Want me to get started?

Thierry, Kitebright Studio
kitebright.hq@gmail.com

If this isn't useful, reply 'no' and I won't email again.
